title: Consumer compatibility
summary: Every upstream PR, main push and manual candidate is checked independently of required CI. A main push or manual run starts the release gate's exact product/consumer commit-pair proof at an immutable consumer tag, in a per-commit concurrency group a newer push never cancels; the release of that commit joins the running or passed run and dispatches again only for a moved Platform main or a failed run. For PRs, identical product trees at the same observed Platform commit reuse the durable original dispatch and its run, including after a rebase. Merge-queue groups do not dispatch one. Release publication still requires the exact product/consumer commit pair. The advisory reads its dispatch receipt on the consumer project's run-read permission, which the release identity's deployment_ci role carries; an engine serving below that grant reports NOT CHECKED with dispatch_receipt_unauthorized and never asks for project admin. Release gates reuse an existing passed durable dispatch for the same exact product/consumer pair across environments; they verify the original run and consumer head again before acceptance. Advisory tree equivalence never substitutes for release pair identity.
